pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with predominantly angular edges and sharp pixel gradients. The dark contiguous patches occupy a significantly larger spatial area on the flank than the intervening light regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a topological graph. Pathways exhibit relatively uniform pixel thickness on the mid-flank, with clearly defined junction nodes connecting multiple pathways.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the neck and upper shoulder, representing the hair of the mane against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A large, localized, bulbous mass is present on the posterior dorsal ridge. It displays significant textural disruption, appearing raised and uneven with altered pigmentation compared to the standard pelage pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark avian subject (oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal ridge near the base of the neck, creating a distinct localized silhouette break.
